summary: Entry operational grades - foundational DDI & AI maturity targets Working where the capability is used daily; Awareness is the floor, not the ceiling.
Executive Officer - coordinates work and supports colleagues. Working is the maturity target on foundational strands; Practitioner may be demonstrated through informal influence.
Higher Executive Officer - owns workstreams and often supports or line-manages others. Practitioner is a realistic maturity target where DDI & AI is core to the role.
Senior Executive Officer - leads workstreams and often line-manages staff. Practitioner is a realistic maturity target; Expert possible with wider remit.
Grade 7 - team or unit lead. Practitioner is the expected maturity band; Expert is realistic with formal specialist or cross-team remit.
Grade 6 - senior leader or programme director. Practitioner is the floor; Expert is the maturity target where DDI & AI is in scope.
Senior Civil Service - strategic authority. Expert outcomes are possible where DDI & AI direction is part of the role.
